checks.name: action-pinning
checks.summary: action-pinning: every GitHub Actions `uses:` is pinned to a commit SHA.

checks.name: behavioral-claims
checks.summary: behavioral-claims: prose claims cite tests that actually exist.

checks.name: boundaries
checks.summary: boundaries: architectural layering rules are grep-enforced.

checks.name: count-drift
checks.summary: count-drift: inventory facts live in one place, not restated as numerals.

checks.name: doc-completeness
checks.summary: doc-completeness: every doc under a doc_root is mapped or declared.

checks.name: doc-coverage
checks.summary: doc-coverage: every code module must be documented *somewhere*.

checks.name: doc-drift
checks.summary: doc-drift: code that a doc describes cannot move without the doc.

checks.name: doc-taxonomy
checks.summary: doc-taxonomy: every doc must declare a lifecycle class.

checks.name: file-line-refs
checks.summary: file-line-refs: enduring docs and source comments cite symbols, not lines.

checks.name: generated-freshness
checks.summary: generated-freshness: generated docs must diff clean against their generator.

checks.name: snippet-regions
checks.summary: snippet-regions: doc references to code regions resolve to real markers.

checks.name: status-prose
checks.summary: status-prose: ban stale progress-tracking prose in gated docs.
